description: High ramification and fixed-component leaves now have conditional closures. The remaining calculation is the exceptional triple-ramification F4 compatibility system, followed by a global audit that every quartic map reaches a recorded terminal chart.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an exact LaTeX location for every program-relevant defining claim. A locator records where the current statement and evidence boundary appear; it is not a proof-review status.

members.statement: Assuming the Program 2 structural inputs, in the coprime binary-pencil locus with ramification divisor of degree three, the type-(2,5) and generic type-(3,4) Hilbert--Burch branches are automorphic or enter previously excluded cube, fourth-power, fixed-component, or source-shear boundaries; any remaining generic normal deformation lies on the explicit F4 weighted-inflection family.
members.title: Triple Binary Ramification Reduces to an Explicit Weighted-Inflection Family

members.statement: Complete the uniform extension-field compatibility calculation on the exceptional triple-ramification F4 family, including every denominator and rank-minor divisor, and independently audit that the leading-curve and four-loci reductions route every quartic target-span-two map into exactly one recorded terminal chart.
members.title: Can the Exceptional F4 System and a Global Audit Close Degree Four?

members.statement: Assume the Program 2 structural reductions place a quartic Keller map in the primitive coprime binary-pencil locus, with H4=(P,Q,0), P,Q in k[x,y]_4 coprime, R=(H3)_3 in k[x,y]_3, U=J(Q,R), V=J(P,R), W=J(P,Q), and r=deg gcd(U,V,W). If r is four or five, then the full Keller map is a polynomial automorphism.
members.title: Primitive Binary Ramification Four and Five Is Automorphic

members.statement: Assume the Program 2 four-loci reduction and the standard polynomial-centralizer theorem used in the proof note. Every genuinely nonbinary primitive fixed-component branch is closed: a fixed factor of degree two is eliminated by the corrected valuation identity or enters the existing same-fiber rank-one chart, while a fixed factor of degree one is aligned-automorphic, binary, or incompatible with the Keller condition.
members.title: Genuinely Nonbinary Primitive Fixed Components Are Closed

members.statement: Assume the Program 2 reductions reach a binary leading pencil H4=(P,Q,0) whose greatest common divisor G has degree two and whose residual binary quadrics are coprime. Then the residual pencil is a secant of the Veronese conic and may be normalized to P=x^2G, Q=y^2G; the generic first-normal complement and all four exceptional divisors QF1 through QF4 contain no counterexample, so the full Keller map is a polynomial automorphism.
members.title: Binary Quadratic Fixed Factors Are Automorphic
